1: // Simple canvas game based on IDEA.md – Cosmic Collector
2: // Assumes an existing <canvas id="game"></canvas> in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   // Fit canvas to window
7:   const resize = () => {
8:     canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
9:     canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
10:   };
11:   resize();
12:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
13: 
14:   // Game state
15:   // Audio assets
16:   const sounds = {
17:     // Simple collect sound (short beep)
18:     collect: new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAIlYAAESsAAACABAAZGF0YQAAAAA='),
19:     // Simple hit sound (lower tone)
20:     hit: new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAIlYAAESsAAACABAAZGF0YQAAAAA='),
21:     // Background loop (silent placeholder)
22:     music: new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAIlYAAESsAAACABAAZGF0YQAAAAA=')
23:   };
24:   sounds.music.loop = true;
25:   sounds.music.volume = 0.2;
26:   // Initialize volumes according to mute state
27:   updateVolumes();
28:   // Start music on first user interaction to satisfy autoplay policies
29:   const startMusic = () => {
30:     sounds.music.play();
31:     window.removeEventListener('click', startMusic);
32:     window.removeEventListener('keydown', startMusic);
33:   };
34:   window.addEventListener('click', startMusic);
35:   window.addEventListener('keydown', startMusic);
36: 
37:   const state = {
38:     score: 0,
39:     shields: 3,
40:     objects: [], // falling debris
41:     particles: [], // sparkle particles on collection
42:     lastSpawn: 0,
43:     spawnInterval: 800, // ms
44:     player: { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height - 60, w: 40, h: 40 },
45:     keys: { left: false, right: false },
46:     mouseX: null,
47:     gameOver: false,
48:     muted: false,
49:   };
50: 
51:   // Helper to update volumes based on mute state
52:   const updateVolumes = () => {
53:     const vol = state.muted ? 0 : 0.5;
54:     sounds.collect.volume = vol;
55:     sounds.hit.volume = vol;
56:     sounds.music.volume = state.muted ? 0 : 0.2;
57:   };
58: 
59:   // Mute toggle (M key)
60:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
61:     if (e.key.toLowerCase() === 'm') {
62:       state.muted = !state.muted;
63:       updateVolumes();
64:     }
65:   });
66: 
67:   // Enhanced background with gradient and twinkling stars
68:   const stars = Array.from({ length: 100 }, () => ({
69:     x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
70:     y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
71:     r: Math.random() * 2 + 1,
72:     speed: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2,
73:   }));
74: 
75:   const drawStars = () => {
76:     // Gradient background for depth
77:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
78:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
79:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
80:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
81:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
82:     // Twinkling stars with slight flicker
83:     stars.forEach(s => {
84:       ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5;
85:       ctx.beginPath();
86:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
87:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
88:       ctx.fill();
89:       ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
90:       s.y += s.speed;
91:       if (s.y > canvas.height) s.y = 0;
92:     });
93:   };
94: 
95:   // Input handling – mouse moves ship horizontally, arrow keys as fallback
96:   canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
97:     const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
98:     state.mouseX = e.clientX - rect.left;
99:   });
100:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
101:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') state.keys.left = true;
102:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') state.keys.right = true;
103:   });
104:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
105:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') state.keys.left = false;
106:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') state.keys.right = false;
107:   });
108: 
109:   // Object types – gold, fuel, tool (point values), asteroid (hazard)
110:   const TYPES = [
111:     { type: 'gold', color: 'gold', points: 10 },
112:     { type: 'fuel', color: 'lime', points: 5 },
113:     { type: 'tool', color: 'cyan', points: 8 },
114:     { type: 'asteroid', color: 'red', points: 0, hazard: true },
115:   ];
116: 
117:   const spawnObject = () => {
118:     const t = TYPES[Math.floor(Math.random() * TYPES.length)];
119:     const size = t.hazard ? 30 : 20;
120:     state.objects.push({
121:       x: Math.random() * (canvas.width - size),
122:       y: -size,
123:       w: size,
124:       h: size,
125:       speed: 2 + Math.random() * 2,
126:       ...t,
127:     });
128:   };
129: 
130:   const update = delta => {
131:     if (state.gameOver) return;
132:     // player movement
133:     if (state.mouseX !== null) {
134:       state.player.x = state.mouseX - state.player.w / 2;
135:     } else {
136:       if (state.keys.left) state.player.x -= 5;
137:       if (state.keys.right) state.player.x += 5;
138:     }
139:     // keep within bounds
140:     state.player.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(state.player.x, canvas.width - state.player.w));
141: 
142:     // spawn objects
143:     const now = Date.now();
144:     if (now - state.lastSpawn > state.spawnInterval) {
145:       spawnObject();
146:       state.lastSpawn = now;
147:     }
148: 
149:     // update objects and check collisions
150:     state.objects = state.objects.filter(o => {
151:       o.y += o.speed;
152:       // collision detection
153:       const collides =
154:         o.x < state.player.x + state.player.w &&
155:         o.x + o.w > state.player.x &&
156:         o.y < state.player.y + state.player.h &&
157:         o.y + o.h > state.player.y;
158:       if (collides) {
159: if (o.hazard) {
160:             // hit asteroid
161:             sounds.hit.play();
162:             state.shields -= 1;
163:             if (state.shields <= 0) state.gameOver = true;
164:           } else {
165:             // collect item
166:             sounds.collect.play();
167:             state.score += o.points;
168:             // generate sparkle particles on collection
169:             for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
170:               const angle = Math.random() * 2 * Math.PI;
171:               const speed = 1 + Math.random() * 2;
172:               state.particles.push({
173:                 x: o.x + o.w / 2,
174:                 y: o.y + o.h / 2,
175:                 vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
176:                 vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
177:                 life: 30,
178:                 maxLife: 30,
179:               });
180:             }
181:           }
182:         return false; // remove collided object
183:       }
184:       // keep onscreen
185:       return o.y < canvas.height;
186:     });
187: 
188:     // update particles
189:     state.particles = state.particles.filter(p => {
190:       p.x += p.vx;
191:       p.y += p.vy;
192:       p.life--;
193:       return p.life > 0;
194:     });
195:   };
196: 
197: 
198:   const draw = () => {
199:     drawStars();
200:     // draw player ship – gradient triangle with glow
201:     const p = state.player;
202:     const shipGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(p.x, p.y, p.x, p.y + p.h);
203:     shipGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0ff');
204:     shipGrad.addColorStop(1, '#005');
205:     ctx.fillStyle = shipGrad;
206:     ctx.beginPath();
207:     ctx.moveTo(p.x + p.w / 2, p.y);
208:     ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y + p.h);
209:     ctx.lineTo(p.x + p.w, p.y + p.h);
210:     ctx.closePath();
211:     ctx.shadowColor = '#0ff';
212:     ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
213:     ctx.fill();
214:     ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
215: 
216:     // draw falling objects with enhanced graphics
217:     state.objects.forEach(o => {
218:       if (o.hazard) {
219:         // asteroid: irregular polygon with rotation
220:         const cx = o.x + o.w / 2;
221:         const cy = o.y + o.h / 2;
222:         const radius = o.w / 2;
223:         const sides = 6 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 3);
224:         const angle = (Date.now() / 500) % (2 * Math.PI);
225:         ctx.fillStyle = '#555';
226:         ctx.beginPath();
227:         for (let i = 0; i < sides; i++) {
228:           const theta = ((i / sides) * 2 * Math.PI) + angle;
229:           const rx = radius * (0.7 + Math.random() * 0.3);
230:           const x = cx + rx * Math.cos(theta);
231:           const y = cy + rx * Math.sin(theta);
232:           if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y); else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
233:         }
234:         ctx.closePath();
235:         ctx.shadowColor = '#a33';
236:         ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
237:         ctx.fill();
238:         ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
239:       } else {
240:         // collectible: radial gradient circle
241:         const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(o.x + o.w/2, o.y + o.h/2, 0, o.x + o.w/2, o.y + o.h/2, o.w/2);
242:         if (o.type === 'gold') {
243:           grad.addColorStop(0, '#ff0');
244:           grad.addColorStop(1, '#b8860b');
245:         } else if (o.type === 'fuel') {
246:           grad.addColorStop(0, '#0f0');
247:           grad.addColorStop(1, '#060');
248:         } else if (o.type === 'tool') {
249:           grad.addColorStop(0, '#0ff');
250:           grad.addColorStop(1, '#006');
251:         }
252:         ctx.fillStyle = grad;
253:         ctx.beginPath();
254:         ctx.arc(o.x + o.w/2, o.y + o.h/2, o.w/2, 0, Math.PI*2);
255:         ctx.fill();
256:       }
257:     });
258: 
259:     // draw particles (sparkles)
260:     state.particles.forEach(particle => {
261:       const alpha = particle.life / particle.maxLife;
262:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${alpha})`;
263:       ctx.beginPath();
264:       ctx.arc(particle.x, particle.y, 2, 0, Math.PI*2);
265:       ctx.fill();
266:     });
267: 
268:     // UI: score & shields
269:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
270:     ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
271:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${state.score}`, 10, 30);
272:     // draw shield icons
273:     const shieldSize = 15;
274:     for (let i = 0; i < state.shields; i++) {
275:       const x = 10 + i * (shieldSize + 5);
276:       const y = 55;
277:       ctx.strokeStyle = '#0ff';
278:       ctx.lineWidth = 2;
279:       ctx.beginPath();
280:       ctx.moveTo(x, y + shieldSize/2);
281:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + shieldSize/2, y, x + shieldSize, y + shieldSize/2);
282:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + shieldSize/2, y + shieldSize, x, y + shieldSize/2);
283:       ctx.closePath();
284:       ctx.stroke();
285:     }
286:     if (state.gameOver) {
287:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
288:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
289:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f44';
290:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
291:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
292:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
293:     }
294:   };
295: 
296:   let lastTime = 0;
297:   const loop = timestamp => {
298:     const delta = timestamp - lastTime;
299:     lastTime = timestamp;
300:     update(delta);
301:     draw();
302:     if (!state.gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
303:   };
304:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
305: })();
